title: Process Kill Proof Gate Reference
desc: Dated incident record for cross-repository Codex process termination without identity proof.
steps: INCIDENT 2026-09-17: Three codex.exe PIDs were force-terminated after only image name and start time were observed. No command line, parent, working directory, or owner proof was collected.
IMPACT: The same machine had Codex sessions in three different repositories, so process-name enumeration could not identify the intended session and may have terminated unrelated work.
ROOT CLASS: Identity collapse. A shared executable name was incorrectly treated as session ownership.
CORRECTION: Never claim a PID belongs to the current job without command-line and repository evidence. If the evidence cannot be read, classify as unknown and do not kill.
VERIFICATION: The failure is prevented only when the harness rejects raw termination before proof and requires a classified dry-run plus post-kill inventory.
NAVIGATION: Read harness-process-kill-proof-gate for the reflex and harness-process-kill-proof-gate-howto for the procedure.

requirements.expect: exact PID and missing proof fields are preserved
